sources.entry: 🧰 ⭐️ donnemartin/system-design-primer: learn how to design large scale systems. Prep for the system design interview.

summary.one_liner: A large open-source study guide of system design concepts, trade-offs, and interview preparation resources, with sample solutions for common design questions.
summary.what_it_does: The repo is an organized collection of system design material aimed at learning how to build large-scale systems and preparing for system design interviews. It has an index of topics covering performance vs scalability, latency vs throughput, CAP theorem and consistency patterns, availability patterns, DNS, CDNs, load balancers, reverse proxies, application layer and microservices, databases (SQL, sharding, replication, denormalization, NoSQL), caching strategies, asynchronism, and communication protocols. It includes a study guide by interview timeline, a step-by-step approach to answering design questions, and a list of practice questions such as designing Pastebin, a Twitter timeline, a web crawler, and a key-value store, with solutions in a solutions/ folder. It also covers object-oriented design questions, back-of-the-envelope reference tables, and links to real-world architectures and company engineering blogs. Anki flashcard decks are provided, and the README notes a sister repo for coding interview prep.
use_cases: Prepare for a system design interview
Learn how large-scale systems are architected
Study trade-offs between consistency, availability, and latency
Practice designing URL shorteners, web crawlers, or feeds
Review caching, sharding, and replication strategies
Use spaced-repetition flashcards for system design concepts
notable: Covers breadth of distributed systems topics with pros and cons for each
Interview study guide with short, medium, and long timeline suggestions
Practice questions with sample solutions, diagrams, and discussions
Translated into many languages and open to community contributions
Includes Anki decks for spaced repetition review
caveats: Object-oriented design section is marked as under development
Some sections are incomplete and link out to external resources for depth
Content is reference material rather than runnable software
